At the end of the race less than a minute separated Bill Weller from the winner, Mick Woods of Aldershot. Unfortunately the stronger members of the road running team were on this occasion on duty at Cambridge, shoring up the track and field team so we were unable to score in the team race.
This turned out to be the case with Mike Hurd winning from Dave Patterson and Mike Woods. Pat O'Connor recorded his first Belgrave Championship win with Rex Bale second and Doug Maughan 3rd.
Won by M.Woods of AFD with D.Clack finishing 44th in 3.02.09 & J.Wasbrough 126th in 3.18.02. In the half Marathon T.Grant finished 10th in 1.22.49 while N.Kidd was 37th with 1.28.01.
